details: Decrypt has partnered with Solana infrastructure provider Helius to introduce confidential transfers within its Money Account. This new feature utilizes Solana Privacy Rings, a system that encrypts transaction amounts, though sender and recipient wallet addresses will remain publicly visible. This initiative is part of Decrypt's broader vision to evolve into "The Information Exchange," a platform aiming to seamlessly combine crypto news, trading, and prediction markets.
title: Decrypt Integrates Confidential Transfers on Solana

details: Bitcoin's price has experienced a notable slip, dropping to around $74,200 and further to $73,762, following the release of the latest US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data. This decline occurred despite a general rebound observed in US stock markets. Concurrently, US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), particularly BlackRock's IBIT, have recorded net outflows for the seventh consecutive trading session, totaling $201 million on Monday. The broader cryptocurrency market has also seen a decrease in its total market capitalization.
title: Bitcoin Dips as ETF Outflows Continue Post-CPI

details: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) has selected Avalanche's blockchain to serve as the core ledger for clearing and settlement on its forthcoming tokenized stock trading platform. This significant announcement led to a considerable price surge for Avalanche's native token, AVAX, which increased by as much as 10%. While this marks a major institutional validation for Avalanche and tokenized assets, the NYSE's platform will reportedly not permit direct wallet access for users.
title: NYSE Partners with Avalanche for Tokenized Stock Trading

details: With the Democratic Party now holding control of the US Congress, the cryptocurrency sector is anticipating increased scrutiny and potentially more stringent regulations. Congressman Robert Garcia (D-Calif.), expected to chair the House Oversight Committee, has indicated that his committee will focus investigations on the crypto industry, including any connections to former President Trump. Crypto firms that have previously been unresponsive to congressional inquiries are advised to prepare for direct questioning.
title: US Congress Poised for Stricter Crypto Oversight

details: Bitcoin traders have increasingly resorted to leveraged borrowing during market downturns, a pattern that has occurred five times since October. The previous four instances each resulted in over $800 million in long liquidations. Recent market data shows a 15% decrease in CME open interest, while offshore leveraged positions have risen, suggesting that institutional investors are reducing their exposure as retail traders take on more risk. Bitcoin is currently trading marginally above its 200-day moving average, making a drop below $72,350 a critical indicator for a potential bearish trend.
title: Bitcoin Leveraged Longs at Risk Amid Falling Market
